about: Orangeville is a town in Dufferin County, Ontario, northwest of the Greater Toronto Area on the upper Credit River. It serves as the county seat and a service hub for surrounding farmland and hill country toward the Niagara Escarpment. A Victorian downtown and Island Lake are the town’s public landmarks. About 30,000 people live in Orangeville.
